propositions: After Jira create returns a key, the known key must be persisted on the still-pending RP-02 entry via record_pending_key+save BEFORE attempting the canonical label attachment, ensuring deterministic recovery from create→label window crashes.
The canonical rebar-id label must be attached before attempting optional entity property enrichment, and property failures must remain visible without erasing the label floor.
Local binding confirmation via bind_confirm must occur LAST, after the canonical label is attached and key is durable, so confirmation ordering follows label attachment.

Any post-create failure (label, property, or persistence) must preserve the known key, keyed-pending recovery evidence, and remote issue (never delete), while reporting the exact typed terminal disposition.
Lifecycle intents following create must execute only after their remote postconditions are proven, preventing premature convergence attempts on partial state.
